newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus announces orders by Singapore's SilkAir.
newsitem.headline: Airbus announces orders by Singapore's SilkAir.

text.p: European aircraft consortium Airbus said Monday that Singapore Airlines regional carrier unit SilkAir had made firm orders for three A319 aircraft and five A320s and had options for 10 more planes.
"This package covers firm orders for three 124-seat A319s and five 150-seat A320s, plus options for a further 10 aircraft of any type from the family," the consortium said in a statement.
"In addition to the A319 and A320, this also includes the 185-seat A321, which would be able to meet the airline's future growth requirements at the upper end of the regional market." it said.

Airbus Industrie is a consortium made up of France's state-owned Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Germany's Daimler-Benz AG and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
The aircraft on firm order are scheduled for delivery starting September 1998. No value was given for the deal.
